scope: Stable custom-field identity in the metadata-only integration dictionary

behavior.definition_identity: Owning directory tenant, entity, definition table and original definition ID
behavior.missing_or_invalid_key: Retain definition identity, export a null lookup path, and require stable-key review

scenarios: Dedicated person and legacy field keys retain their lookup paths
Duplicate display labels have distinct definition identities
Renaming a display label does not rename the definition identity
Missing or invalid keys never become invented mapping targets
Owner, entity, archived-definition and field-visibility boundaries remain enforced

limitations: The read-only hosted inspector verifies the installed dictionary version and existing demo records; legacy custom-field behavior is covered by isolated MariaDB fixtures.
This does not establish complete actual Thunderhawk standard/custom-field alignment or its end-to-end round trip.
Worker login, independent time approval, reviewed payroll-input/result exchange and production release requirements remain open.
